name: obsidian-linker
description: Obsidian-style [[wikilinks]] for VS Code: Ctrl/Cmd+Click to open notes (new tab / split), hover actions, and open the current file in Obsidian.

enumDescriptions: VS Code default: opens in the current editor group (may reuse a preview tab)
Opens a pinned (non-preview) tab in the current editor group
Opens in a split editor to the right
obsidian-linker.openMode.description: How [[wikilinks]] are opened (applies to Ctrl/Cmd+Click, the command, and hover buttons). Reopen the file or edit it once after changing this setting.

obsidian-linker.vaultName.description: Optional Obsidian vault name used by 'Open in Obsidian'. When empty, Obsidian resolves the vault from the absolute path automatically.

obsidian-linker.indexOnlyMarkdown.description: Index only Markdown (.md) files. Saves memory for large vaults, but wikilinks to images, PDFs, canvases, etc. will no longer resolve.

obsidian-linker.indexExclude.description: Glob patterns of files/folders to exclude from the index, relative to the workspace folder (e.g. [".trash/**", "attachments/archive/**"]). Can be set per project in .vscode/settings.json. The index rebuilds automatically when this changes.

obsidian-linker.indexLimit.description: Maximum number of files to index. 0 (default) means no limit: every file is indexed and memory usage grows with vault size (roughly 1KB per file). If a limit is set and the vault has more files, files beyond the limit are NOT indexed and their wikilinks will show "Note not found".
